title: What family memory asks us to carry—and what it asks us to release
intro: Lineage can be a source of belonging without becoming a weight you must carry alone.

sections.heading: Remember with care
sections.body: Stories can be honored without being romanticized.

sections.heading: Separate love from obligation
sections.body: You can respect where you come from and still choose a different path.

sections.heading: Make a living connection
sections.body: Let memory shape a value, a ritual, or a conversation in the present.
